glosses: a kind of torch or large candle (often with four sticks)
a kind of wick or fuse (often made with esparto grass and tar), which does not go out easily in the wind
bundle of straw tied up like a strip and often used to help cover huts or other field constructions

examples.text: Jamás había utilizado un hacha hasta ahora.
examples.en: Until now I've never used an axe.

examples.text: Él derribó el gran árbol con un hacha.
examples.en: He cut down the big tree with an ax.

examples.text: Antes éramos enemigos, pero hemos enterrado el hacha de guerra y ahora nos llevamos bien.
examples.en: At one time we were enemies, but we've buried the hatchet and we are now on friendly terms with each other.
